metadata.title: Veil — Passkey-Powered Stellar Wallets
metadata.description: A seedless, biometric-native smart wallet built on Stellar Soroban. No seed phrases. No private keys. Just your fingerprint.
metadata.ogDescription: Your biometric IS your key. Seedless smart accounts on Stellar Soroban.
metadata.twitterDescription: No seed phrases. No private keys. Just your fingerprint.

hero.subtitle: Passkey-powered smart accounts on Stellar Soroban. Your biometric is the key — no phrase to write down, no key to lose.

register.title: Register
register.body: Your browser creates a P-256 key pair. The public key goes on-chain. The private key never leaves your device.

approve.title: Approve
approve.body: A biometric prompt — Face ID, fingerprint, Windows Hello — signs the Soroban auth payload. No password. No phrase.

verified.title: Verified
verified.body: The Soroban contract verifies your P-256 ECDSA signature on-chain. Trustless. Invisible. Done.

noSeedPhrases.title: No Seed Phrases
noSeedPhrases.body: Nothing to write down, nothing to lose. Your biometric is the only key you need.

noExtensions.title: No Browser Extensions
noExtensions.body: Works in any modern browser. No installs, no plugins, no platform lock-in.

accountAbstraction.title: Account Abstraction
accountAbstraction.body: Soroban custom accounts unlock gas sponsorship, multi-sig, and social recovery — built-in.

comparison.label: How We Stack Up
comparison.regionLabel: Feature comparison: Veil vs Freighter vs xBull
comparison.caption: Feature comparison between Veil, Freighter, and xBull Stellar wallets

devQuickstart.description: The Veil SDK wraps the full WebAuthn + Soroban pipeline into a single React hook. Register a passkey wallet, sign auth entries, and recover accounts — without touching a private key.

ecosystem.description: Veil wallets are Soroban custom account contracts — a native Stellar primitive. Each transaction settles with Stellar finality: sub-cent fees, 3–5 second confirmation, and the full security of the Stellar network backing every signature.

earlyAccess.description: Be first to build on Veil. We're onboarding developers and design partners ahead of the public Testnet launch.
earlyAccess.subtext: No spam. No seed phrases. Obviously.
